newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo ups India rates 15-70pct.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo ups India rates 15-70pct.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG (LCAG said it will raise rates to all destinations in India with effect from January 1 to try to end its losses in the region.
Rates rises will vary between 15 and 70 percent according to destination and weight category, the Deutsche Lufthansa AG cargo subsidiary said in a statement.
Market rates to India are currently lying in the 1.60-1.70 marks per kilo for a 100kg shipment range after collapsing to below 1.50 in the summer, industry sources said.
The increase is a reaction to the continual fall in average yields on India routes in recent years, the cargo airline said.
"It has not been possible to operate freight services for Indian destinations economically viably for some time," the LCAG statement said.
"The situation has worsened in recent months with the result that Lufthansa Cargo sees itself forced to an immediate correction in order to maintain its freight service to India."
Lufthansa Cargo said it flies to Bangalore, Delhi, Hyderabad, Calcutta, Madras, Bombay and Trivandrum. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
